races.paceDynamic: Naughty Niall will set the pace from the front with Daring Leader likely taking him on early, creating a genuine tempo through the middle sections of this 1m1½f contest. With most of the field comprising hold-up horses (Ciotog, Crafter, Port Noir, Dors Delight, Dinah Myte, Eager Puccini), there will be significant traffic problems in the straight as they all look for racing room simultaneously. The sustained pace set by the front two should set up perfectly for those that can secure a clean passage from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and those hold-up horses with tactical pace who can avoid the inevitable traffic jam.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall and Daring Leader go too fast early and tie each other up
scenarios.body: The pace will be unsustainable and they'll come back to the hold-up horses in the final furlong. Port Noir with her C&D winning form can time her challenge perfectly under Rose Dawes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical pace holds firm
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall gets an easy lead without serious pressure from Daring Leader
scenarios.body: The pace will be manageable allowing the front runners to kick clear in the straight before the hold-up brigade can organize. Naughty Niall's course form gives him the edge over Daring Leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos benefits outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses all get blocked simultaneously in the straight
scenarios.body: One of the lesser fancied runners who gets a clear run will pick up the pieces while favorites struggle for room. Kaaress is well handicapped and could benefit from the mayhem.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed holds throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Naughty Niall gets completely uncontested fractions and Daring Leader tracks rather than challenges
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Naughty Niall to control the race completely and his finishing kick proves decisive. His course winning form over 1m4f suggests he has the stamina to see this out.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems in the straight as six hold-up horses (Ciotog, Crafter, Port Noir, Dors Delight, Dinah Myte, Eager Puccini) will all need room simultaneously
Monitor the early fractions between Naughty Niall and Daring Leader as their battle will determine if the pace collapses
Port Noir's partnership with Rose Dawes is 3-from-5 this year and they know this C&D well from their February win
Ciotog hung left badly last time at Bath which could be problematic in a tight finish
Watch for any market support for Kaaress who could be well handicapped off his current mark after that Lingfield win

races.paceDynamic: Astrological will set a sustainable early pace from his prominent position, with no other confirmed front-runners to apply pressure through the first half of this 1m1½f contest. The moderate gallop will allow the field to stay bunched longer than usual, setting up a tactical finish where positioning becomes crucial. Hold-up horses like Zooter and Maryland Star will get their preferred slower rhythm, while Astrological can dictate terms without being harassed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can finish, as the steady pace will ensure plenty left in the tank for the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Astrological sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The steady gallop plays perfectly into the hands of horses with finishing kicks like Zooter and Maryland Star. Late runners get the ideal setup with energy preserved for a strong finish where class can tell.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Astrological wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the favourite can maintain his recent improvement and the pace stays controlled
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to track the moderate tempo before asserting in the straight. The lack of early pressure means he retains enough energy to resist late challenges from hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical scramble develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge in the final furlong creating a messy finish
scenarios.body: The steady early pace leaves several runners with chances turning for home, leading to traffic problems and hard-luck stories. Jockey positioning becomes critical in the confined straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Astrological goes too slow and the field crawls through early splits
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole where any horse can win regardless of ability. Random factors like luck in running and rail position determine the outcome more than class.

watchPoints.text: Astrological may get too easy a lead if no horse challenges his early position, allowing him to steal the race
Helios Path could be anything returning from long break with gear change but his debut was concerning
Zooter's fitness after 194 days off will be key to his chances despite the favourable race setup
Maryland Star showed signs of staying power last time and this slower pace could unlock improvement
Multiple hold-up horses may get in each other's way in the home straight if they all come with runs together

races.paceDynamic: Midnight Call is the lone confirmed front runner and will likely get an uncontested lead, setting a sustainable pace that won't crack under pressure. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics (Coolagh Magic, Henery Hawk, Some Nightmare, Neptune Legend, Isla Bella, Comedian Leader, Charging Bull), the pace will be honest but not frantic. Kento and Nad Alshiba Snow may sit prominent behind Midnight Call, but the lack of early pace pressure means the leader can dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the late traffic problems that will inevitably affect the large hold-up contingent.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Midnight Call Dominates Front
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Call gets the expected uncontested lead and maintains her rhythm.
scenarios.body: She can control the pace completely and kick for home when ready, leaving the hold-up horses with too much ground to make up in a sprint finish. Her four recent course wins from November to January prove she thrives when allowed to dictate from the front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Kento and Nad Alshiba Snow track Midnight Call closely and time their challenges perfectly.
scenarios.body: They get first run on the leader while avoiding the traffic problems further back, with Kento's proven C&D form giving him the edge in a driving finish. The prominent position allows them to strike at the optimal moment.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainably fast or the prominent horses weaken dramatically.
scenarios.body: Coolagh Magic or Henery Hawk could benefit from a strong pace collapse, but they need significant help from traffic and pace angles. Their proven course form gives them the best chance among the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Completely Collapses
scenarios.trigger: If Midnight Call goes too slow early and gets swamped by superior finishing speed.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint where class tells, but this requires the pace to be genuinely crawling. Even then, the hold-up horses face significant traffic issues in a large field.

watchPoints.text: Midnight Call must be watched for any signs of over-racing early as her front-running dominance depends entirely on relaxing in front
Kento and Nad Alshiba Snow need to be positioned close enough to Midnight Call to avoid getting trapped behind the large hold-up contingent
Traffic issues in the final furlong could be severe with eight hold-up horses converging simultaneously
Any significant early pace pressure on Midnight Call would completely change the race dynamics and favour closers
The large field size makes draw positions crucial for the hold-up horses to get clear runs at the business end

races.paceDynamic: Renesmee will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with Pearly Squirrel likely to sit in second early before the two hold-up horses Camino Del Ray and Youarenotforgiven track from behind. With only four runners and one clear leader, Renesmee can dictate a comfortable gallop without pressure, setting up a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. The lack of pace pressure means the two prominent runners can control the tempo, while the hold-up pair face the challenge of making ground from the back in a small field. This shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can control their destiny from forward positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Renesmee Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Renesmee gets an uncontested lead and kicks at the right moment.
scenarios.body: She can dictate ideal fractions and prove hard to pass, especially with her proven course form and recent Chelmsford success. The hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground in such a small field with limited pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Youarenotforgiven's Late Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow early and Youarenotforgiven gets the perfect run through.
scenarios.body: His recent C&D win and follow-up success show he's in peak form, and Rossa Ryan can time his challenge perfectly if the pace collapses. The prominent runners may go too slow to hold off his sustained finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pearly Squirrel Strikes Again
scenarios.trigger: If Pearly Squirrel can sit second and pounce when Renesmee weakens.
scenarios.body: Her recent 7f win here and close third nine days ago show she's in good heart, and from her tracking position she can strike if the leader falters. The step back to 1m suits her proven versatility.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Camino Del Ray Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes a crawl and his hold-up style gets maximum assistance.
scenarios.body: Ryan Sexton's 7lb claim becomes crucial in a slowly-run race where his fresh legs after 30 days off could tell. His recent form shows consistency even if not winning form.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Renesmee gets too comfortable early - she could steal this with uncontested fractions in a small field
Monitor Youarenotforgiven's position turning in - if he's too far back in this field size he may not get there
Check Pearly Squirrel's early positioning - she needs to be close enough to Renesmee to strike when the moment comes
Observe the overall pace through the first half - if it's crawling it brings Camino Del Ray's hold-up style into play
Watch for traffic problems in the straight with only four runners - clear runs will be at a premium

races.paceDynamic: Artagnan leads early proceedings with Gold Star Hero and Dyrholaey likely pressing from prominent positions, creating a moderate gallop over this 6f trip. City Cyclone and Queue Dos will track just behind this front group, while Tiger Crusade drops in last from his hold-up style. The presence of multiple prominent runners ensures a solid tempo without being suicidal, setting up a tactical sprint finish. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position close to the pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gold Star Hero Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gold Star Hero gets first run from his prominent position
scenarios.body: His recent course win shows he handles these conditions perfectly and the 4lb rise looks manageable given his current form trajectory. The moderate pace allows him to conserve energy for a sustained finish that his 82 TopSpeed suggests he possesses.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Queue Dos Returns Sharp
scenarios.trigger: If Queue Dos shows no signs of her 104-day break
scenarios.body: Her four course wins demonstrate superior track knowledge and the 3lb rise keeps her competitive despite the layoff. The tactical pace suits her prominent style and allows connections to judge when to make their move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: City Cyclone Finds Form
scenarios.trigger: If City Cyclone bounces back from his last disappointing run
scenarios.body: His recent hat-trick including a course win over 7f shows he's in the form of his life when conditions align. The drop back to this grade after facing stronger opposition last time could unlock his best effort.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tiger Crusade Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the early stages
scenarios.body: His hold-up style thrives when front-runners go too slowly, allowing his proven finishing kick to be effective. However, the number of prominent runners makes a truly dawdling pace unlikely over this minimum trip.

Queue Dos shows any signs of rustiness early given her 104-day absence from action
Artagnan's fitness levels after 160 days off despite his previous solid form on return
Dyrholaey's response to first-time blinkers which suggests recent attitude or focus issues
Gold Star Hero's ability to handle the 4lb penalty from his recent course success

races.paceDynamic: On The Inlet will control this race from the front with Lifeguard and Apex Star likely to race prominently, but neither should pressure the leader early given their prominent rather than outright pace-forcing styles. The three hold-up horses (Sup Of Red, Clear Above, Hello Humphrey) will need the pace to collapse or find gaps in the straight. With only one natural front runner and limited early pressure, On The Inlet can dictate comfortable fractions before quickening. This setup clearly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: On The Inlet Wires
scenarios.trigger: If On The Inlet gets uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The improving gelding controls the tempo and has too much class for this field when asked to quicken. His recent 6-length handicap debut win shows he's found his level.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong or On The Inlet stops quickly
scenarios.body: Hello Humphrey or Sup Of Red benefit from a collapse up front with their proven ability to finish strongly. The longer they delay their challenge, the better their chances.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Lifeguard or Apex Star sit closer and outfinish the leader
scenarios.body: A prominent runner gets the perfect trip behind On The Inlet and has enough left to collar him late. Fresh legs prove decisive over 7f.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes tactical with multiple horses in contention turning in, favouring the horse with the best turn of foot regardless of position.

watchPoints.text: On The Inlet must be watched for any signs of taking a strong hold early as he did before his recent win
Hello Humphrey needs monitoring for fitness after 120 days off despite his previous consistent form
Lifeguard's first-time tongue-tie and stable switch could spark improvement after poor recent efforts
The pace could collapse if Lifeguard and Apex Star don't press On The Inlet early enough
Clear Above and Apex Star both gelded since last runs which could bring about improvement

races.paceDynamic: Naana's Crystal will likely dictate terms from the front with no other natural pace-setters in this small field. The prominent runner faces minimal early pressure, allowing her to settle into a comfortable rhythm through the middle stages. Della Pace, Siam Ruby, and Fille Imbassee are all hold-up performers who will track behind and rely on finishing kicks. This creates a tactical setup that strongly favors front-running and prominent racing styles, as the pace-setter can control fractions without being harassed early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Naana's Crystal establishes an easy lead without pressure through the first half-mile
scenarios.body: She can dictate steady fractions and has enough in reserve to resist the late challenges from the hold-up trio. The three closers will be fighting for the same piece of real estate in the straight, potentially compromising each other's finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses time their runs perfectly and Naana's Crystal goes too fast early
scenarios.body: The front-runner weakens in the final furlong as one of the closers produces a decisive late surge. Siam Ruby's recent form and lower weight make her the most likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If Della Pace or another runner tracks closer to dispute the pace with Naana's Crystal
scenarios.body: The increased early tempo sets up the race for a strong stayer, with the two pace protagonists potentially tying each other up. This creates opportunities for the best finisher coming from behind.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Naana's Crystal goes too slow early then stops quickly, leaving the field bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: A scrambling finish develops where positioning and luck become crucial factors. Any of the hold-up horses could capitalize on a chaotic finale where the front-runner fades dramatically.

watchPoints.text: Naana's Crystal's jumping and early fractions - if she breaks slowly or goes too fast early, the race dynamic completely changes
Della Pace's fitness after 197 days off - George Boughey's strike rate is poor but she has course experience if ready
Siam Ruby's position turning for home - she needs room to maneuver and clear running to deploy her superior finishing speed
The pace overall - if it becomes truly pedestrian, it could neutralize the front-runner's advantage and favor the strongest finisher
Fille Imbassee's response to first-time headgear - the hood could sharpen her focus after a disappointing stable debut
